Today I'm harvesting sea buckthorn and making homemade pastila — a delicious fruit leather made from fresh berries. Join me as I gather the harvest, prepare this simple sweet treat, and enjoy the peaceful beauty of village life. I hope this little glimpse into my day brings you a moment of calm. Enjoy watching! 🥰
